publication_scope: Curated aggregate research evidence; not an AWS mirror or complete training archive.

scored.setting: post-competition Kaggle submission; not original competition placement

robustness.setting: Men, 2023-2025, 189 main-bracket games; reused development years

screen.setting: Men, 2017-2019 and 2021-2025; 503 main-bracket games; reused development years

method.target: signed score margin divided by 20; matched control is signed binary outcome
method.calibration: Shared zero-intercept sigmoid method; inner held-out scores

limitations: This is a fuller margin ensemble (three seeds, inner leave-one-season-out), not an exact reproduction of the winner's hyperparameters or calibration.
Assessment is restricted to previously used 2023–2025 development seasons, 189 main-bracket games; not an independent confirmation.
The rich 25% margin blend was selected from four screen proposals on overlapping historical seasons; the bootstrap is conditional, not selection-adjusted proof.
Inner held-out seasons guide early stopping and sigmoid calibration; outer-year outcomes remain excluded from training, early stopping and calibration.
The mean of three seed forecasts is fixed before scoring; seed results are diagnostics, not candidates to pick among.
A pass authorizes candidate-build review only. No 2026 outcomes, prediction file, submission, or leaderboard gain is produced.
Publication reproduces aggregate analyses and figures. Refitting needs retained authorized data, feature cache, frozen probabilities, and the AWS source state; these are not redistributed.
The numerical late-score gap does not establish original placement or guarantee exact scoring-scope equivalence.
next_step: Freeze one 2026 candidate build, validate schema and unchanged women/protected rows, then separately authorize a single submission. No new model is deployed by this publication.
